messages:
kate: opened PR for rate-limits + quotas doc updates: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4948. Includes JS-first SDK snippet, migration mapping, and a new tier table. need a quick pass on wording.

rachel: on it. small note: 'RetryAfter' typo in examples — should be 'Retry-After'. also the tier names are quite long; mobile view breaks the layout.

ivan: good catch. i'll add a responsive class in the css and shorten display names in the table (full names in the caption).

kate: also added a migration example mapping old per-minute quotas to per-second + burst credits. please sanity-check numbers.

leo: checked math: OLD 1200/min -> NEW 20/s with burst=200 looks correct. i left an inline suggestion to call out burst refill rate (1 token/sec per unit).

rachel: added a tiny JS snippet showing header fallback: if you don't send X-Redwood-Plan, server treats request as 'free-tier'.

docs-bot: linkcheck + spellcheck passed for PR #4948. merge queued for 17:45 UTC.

kate: thanks team — will follow up with a short note in the changelog about the quota mapping.
